title: Threshing Floor
summary: A threshing floor was a prepared place where grain was separated from husks, often in an open area where wind could assist winnowing.
background: Threshing floors appear in narratives, worship settings, judgment imagery, and scenes of providence. The image of separating grain from chaff becomes a powerful biblical metaphor.
teachingHelp: Use threshing floor background to clarify the agricultural process and the spiritual imagery of separation, judgment, and harvest.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
